conclusion: abs(epstein_completed(0.8+85.7i, (2,1,3))) is 4.84638192796e-35 at dps=20 and 1.61745263238e-58 at dps=60, a gap of 23 orders of magnitude; dps=80 reproduces the dps=60 value to all twelve digits printed, so the low-precision value carries no correct digits rather than fewer. The cap at zeta/epstein.py:1091-1093 therefore costs the entire value at this point, because epstein_completed reaches 1.6e-58 by cancelling O(1) incomplete-gamma terms and 20 digits do not survive 58 digits of cancellation.
confidence: High on the two numbers and on which one is the function. Two independent grounds: the value stops moving between dps=60 and dps=80, and a route that touches neither lattice sum (the gamma factor alone gives 2.6400016e-58) implies |zeta_Q(0.8+85.7i)| = 0.613 for the dps=60 value against 1.8e+23 for the dps=20 value, and no Epstein zeta of a positive definite form takes 1.8e+23 at height 85.7. Low on anything beyond this one point: one point off the critical line is not a characterisation of the cap, and no battery verdict was tested.
